hero.name: Queen's Head
hero.silhouette: Mushroom (hoodoo) rock with a slender eroded neck and a head tilted like a profile facing the sea

crop: The Queen's Head zone on the first section of the cape: the sandstone platform around the rock, the nearby hoodoo cluster and the shoreline on the sea side. Not the whole cape.
orientation: Cape extends north-east into the sea; walking path runs along the platform from the park entrance toward the cape tip
lockedIdentity: Yehliu sandstone colour (warm ochre with darker banding)
allowedMiniatureDetails: rope barrier around the Queen's Head
small waves breaking on the platform edge

worldToken.element: Queen's Head rock alone on a small sandstone base
worldToken.notes: Silhouette must read at 48px — keep the neck thin and the head tilt exaggerated slightly.

qa.notes: New generation from real Queen Head close-up + Google 2016 ground panorama + satellite rock zone. Porous dark head, light slender neck and bare sandstone retained. Hero rock exaggerated relative to people; actual minor-rock distribution, tide/shore crop and current erosion pending. Preview review-v1.png only; no automatic master approval.
